name: photo-frame
description: A framed photo (placeholder portrait silhouette on a paper mat, optional `caption` below) and a speech bubble from someone off-screen above it. Params: speech (bubble text), speaker (small name under the speech, optional), caption (under the photo, e.g. 'didi'), side 'left'|'right' (which side the bubble tail sits on, default 'left'), frameWidth (default 620). Frame is tossed in on the cut; the bubble pops 4 frames later.

params.speech: Dekha? Didi ko 20 lakh ka package!
params.caption: didi

example.speech: Dekha? Didi ko 20 lakh ka package!
example.caption: didi
